Introduction

For The More is a four-member virtual South Korean boy group under 99Major. They made their debut on September 30, 2023, with the digital single "Love Set".

Sometime in August 2023, brand new virtual talent agency 99Major revealed For The More as their first virtual entertainer group; at the time it was made up of Byulha, Ssun and Shuhyang, all whom have previously already established themselves as independent virtual entertainers.

On September 2, For The More revealed that they are planning for an original music debut later that month. Eventually on September 23, they revealed that they will make their debut with the digital single "Love Set". The single was eventually released on September 26.

On October 27, 2023, For The More revealed that they will be releasing their first comeback, "End of the Film" soon with a new fourth member. The single was eventually released two days later on October 29; through the music video, the new member was revealed to be Nidi, who introduced himself through his own SNS.
